title: tech-news-reference typed input
description: Input for the scheduled tech-news reference agent. Schedule-triggered agents still need a typed input: the trigger supplies it instead of a fellow, and it must validate the same way.

sources.description: Feeds to collect from. Titles and metadata only — never article bodies.

batchSize.description: Headlines presented per cycle. Bounded because memory sits in every prompt.

preferUnseen.description: Prefer headlines never shown before. Off means a byte-identical batch, which tests nothing — see MEMORY.md, 'the trap that cost a day'.
